csv_project_name: AE for Airport Road Greenway Connector
csv_scope_of_work: This RFLOI is to solicit responses (LETTERS of INTEREST, or LOIs) from qualified firms to provide professional consulting services to: Design the Airport Road Greenway Connector. The project will establish an approximately 7,000-linear-foot, presumptively 8-foot-wide off-road greenway linking the Pinehurst and Southern Pines trail systems. The greenway generally follows the Airport Road corridor between the Forest Creek area in Southern Pines and McKinnon Road in Pinehurst, closing a longenvisioned regional trail gap. The project is intended to create a safe and enjoyable route for walkers, runners, and cyclists; enhance connectivity between regional trail systems; support outdoor recreation and wellness initiatives; and improve multimodal connectivity between jurisdictions.
